patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I've had this smooth, round lump on the back of my wrist for a few weeks. It doesn't really hurt, it's soft and squishy, and it seems to change size. I just want to know it's nothing bad.
presentation.triageNote: 31-year-old female with a smooth lump on the back of her wrist for several weeks. It is soft, mobile, painless, transilluminates, and varies in size; wrist function is normal with no redness or neurological symptoms.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 5 is appropriate because this benign-appearing painless wrist cyst with normal function requires no counted emergency resource.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has a chronic smooth, mobile, transilluminating dorsal wrist lump with normal function and no inflammatory or neurologic features.
clinical.acuityReason: The stable benign characteristics support reassurance and outpatient management.
teachingPoints: Pain, rapid growth, firmness, fixation, neurologic symptoms, or atypical location warrant reassessment.
Aspiration or surgery is usually reserved for persistent symptoms or functional limitation.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Reassurance and optional outpatient hand or primary-care follow-up would allow discharge.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, holding out her wrist, showing a small bump
signs: small round bump on the wrist
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: an asian 31-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: holding out her wrist to show a small round bump. Expression: calm and curious. Clearly visible: a small round bump on the back of the wrist. No text, no logos.
